That means bright knows what clef knows, which means he knows how to be the devil, although clef's body is worthless, so he can't do it in that body, but he might be able to do it in another body. Get it now?

It's "You are jewelry". That spelling is on purpose.

Because Bright is jewelry. It's literally what he (she/they) is (are).

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
To me, it's clear that it's the latter. "You're [a piece of] jewelry". Mostly because Bright doesn't "own" the amulet, he "is" it.
And, 'cause it makes a basass line.

“You forgot one thing though, Jack,” said Clef, feeling his muscles twitching around the cancers forming in his midsection.

“What’s that, Alto?”

“Your jewelry.”

"Oh my, really. I left it in the caffetteria, I searched it all the day! Thanks a lot!"

"You welcomed. By the way, about the kill me thing…"

"Sorry, still going to kill you."

"Farts"

I can't think of a better way to end my evening. But I need to know, and if anybody sees this, please fix:

“You forgot one thing though, Jack,” said Clef, feeling his muscles twitching around the cancers forming in his midsection.

“What’s that, Alto?”

“You're jewelry.”

'You're'; I was about to change it, but I suppose it could be You are jewelry. As in 'You are jewelry, and as such are just as defeatable as any inanimate object.' rather than 'You forgot your jewelry you somabitch. [I'M A COWBOY. ON A STEEEEEL HOORSE IIII RIIIDE. I'M WANTED (WAAANTEEED). DEAD OR ALIIVE (DOOODLE OODLE OODLE DOO, OODLE OODLE DOODLE DOO, DOODLE OODLE, OODLE DOODLE, DOO-OOOOO, BANAH NAH NAH NA NAAAAAAAAH)]'

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
You know, I think a lot (=sometimes) about the whole user avatar stuff on the site, and how that was good back when the site was smaller but how now having a Foundation that's just full of badasses is inconvenient and will lead to poor writing, and yeah, I think that's all true and I understand why it's changed.
But every so often, there's a story like this that just makes me lean back in my chair, grin, nod slowly, and think, "fuck yeah."
Everyone, try that right now. It's really fun.
